source.refresh_observation: Sunday refresh pattern observed; treat as dynamic evidence, not a contractual cadence

rating_fields.games: sample size; use together with RC to judge rating stability
rating_fields.M: money gained in points per game
rating_fields.R: ELO rating taking strength of opposition into account
rating_fields.selection_rule: Do not collapse these into one ad-hoc score. Use R/RC/Games for strength and confidence, M/T for payoff-oriented human utility, and declarer/defender rates for behavioral coverage.

verified_program_fillers.name: xskat
verified_program_fillers.notes: ISS reference program; useful diversity/fallback, not a primary strength anchor

human_product_evaluation.principle: Playing strength for the shipped Skat product is multi-dimensional. Do not optimize only win/loss or ELO.
required_metrics: R with RC and Games for opponent-adjusted strength and confidence
M for payoff-oriented points gained per game
declarer/defender rates and win/loss rates for behavioral decomposition
contract-type, seat, declarer/defender, bidding, discard, and cardplay slices
human_product_evaluation.host_scoring_requirement: ISS M is an external proxy. Before release acceptance, reproduce the same payoff analysis under the exact scoring/money convention used by the target Skat software and its human-facing game mode.
human_product_evaluation.decision_rule: Do not replace the scientific external strength gate with M alone. Require no material strength regression while separately preferring treatments that improve payoff-oriented utility under deployment-valid scoring.
human_product_evaluation.training_use: Use high-M/high-T opponent behavior as a valuable teacher/diagnostic signal, especially where it differs from pure ELO ordering, but preserve frozen evaluation separation.

eligibility: identity captured in raw ISS evidence
prefer Pareto-strong candidates across R, M, T, Games, and RC rather than rank alone
among similar R/RC candidates, prefer better M/T when the goal is human-facing payoff-quality data
do not label an account as a bot/program unless independently verified
do not let filler traffic displace the three primary opponents from core benchmark coverage

post_r9_parallel_policy.principle: maximize useful games per hour without weakening scientific separation or exactly-once recovery
post_r9_parallel_policy.additional_tables: Use one or two primary opponents when available, then fill remaining seats with the strongest eligible online fillers. Prefer verified programs for bot-decision data.
post_r9_parallel_policy.scale_up: Validate 2 concurrent tables first, then 4, then increase only while protocol integrity, exactly-once recovery, mirroring, latency, and opponent availability remain healthy.
post_r9_parallel_policy.training_boundary: High-volume collection is research/training/failure-mining data. Frozen external acceptance identities and holdouts remain isolated and must not be contaminated.
